verdict.rationale: The IRS publishes its own processing clock for one transaction type: e-file provider enrollment approval can take up to 45 days. But this is a static maximum, not a current or live processing time, and no processing times appear in the evidence for founder transactions such as EIN applications by mail or fax, or 83(b) elections. Missing for 10: current or live processing-time figures, processing times for EIN (SS-4 mail/fax) and Form 15620/83(b) filings, and coverage across transaction types.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself

citations.quote: it can take up to 45 days from the date of submission for the IRS to approve your e-file application
